evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-stage atmosphere measurement is unavailable.
Pressure was 2.938 Torr at growth onset with Ar at 100.4 sccm.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.208 Torr despite essentially constant argon flow; the cause and acceptable pressure range are not established.
Temperature is 750.3 °C against 750 °C setpoint, Ar is 100.1 sccm against 100 sccm, and status is running; these do not establish atmosphere integrity.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth-stage pressure limits or normal-run references and a leak/exhaust-conductance check would clarify the pressure rise. Sample characterization is not yet available.
